name: Transmission
description: Simple, léger, parfait pour un Raspberry Pi.
compose:
services:
  transmission:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/transmission:latest
    container_name: transmission
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      - PUID={{PUID}}
      - PGID={{PGID}}
      - TZ={{TZ}}
    ports:
      - "9091:9091"
      - "51413:51413"
      - "51413:51413/udp"
    volumes:
      - {{APPDATA}}/config:/config
      - {{DATA}}/Downloads:/downloads
